skill.name: ai-music
skill.description: Routes AI music generation and editing requests to RunComfy models, then prepares commands for vocals, instrumentals, multilingual songs, inpainting, and outpainting.
skill.summary: Choose a RunComfy music model and prepare a focused generation or audio-editing command.
skill.author: skills-collective

security_audit.summary: All 76 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, documentation links, credential-storage documentation, or model-selection prose. Semantic review found unpinned package execution, external content transmission, and paid jobs without explicit cost confirmation. Publication should require the listed safeguards.

remediation.issue: Setup commands execute packages without immutable versions.
remediation.suggestion: Pin exact npm and npx versions plus an immutable skill repository reference. Require operator review before installation or upgrades.

remediation.issue: Music prompts, lyrics, settings, and audio URLs leave the local environment.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose external recipients before upload. Document retention terms and require confirmation when content may be sensitive or confidential.

remediation.issue: Paid generation can begin without explicit cost approval.
remediation.suggestion: Estimate each request price from model and duration. Require user confirmation before paid jobs, especially batches and long tracks.

content.user_title: Create and Edit AI Music with RunComfy
content.value_statement: Choosing a music model and valid parameters can slow production. This skill routes each request and prepares a RunComfy command for generation or audio editing.
actual_capabilities: Routes generation requests among ElevenLabs Music, ACE Step base, and ACE Step 1.5.
Prepares RunComfy inputs for vocal songs, instrumentals, jingles, soundtracks, and game loops.
Separates ACE Step style tags from structured lyrics and section markers.
Builds time-bounded inpainting requests to replace sections of existing audio.
Builds bidirectional outpainting requests to add an intro, outro, or both.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, an authenticated account, network access, and available service credits.
Does not generate audio locally; prompts, lyrics, settings, and audio URLs are sent to external services.
Editing requires a compatible source-audio URL and supported ACE Step time ranges.
Does not verify lyric rights, guarantee output quality, or determine final commercial licensing.

use_cases.title: Produce campaign music
use_cases.description: Select a premium model and structure a short vocal hook or instrumental for an advertisement.

use_cases.title: Build game audio drafts
use_cases.description: Generate affordable loops and background tracks with varied style tags for rapid prototyping.

use_cases.title: Repair or extend tracks
use_cases.description: Replace a timed section or add an intro and outro without regenerating the complete track.

prompt_templates.title: Create an instrumental
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60-second instrumental for [project]. Use [genre], [mood], and [tempo]. Choose a cost-effective model and explain the selection.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs one background track.

prompt_templates.title: Write a structured vocal song
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a [duration] vocal song in [language]. Use [genre] and [voice style], with verse, chorus, bridge, and original lyrics about [theme].
prompt_templates.scenario: A creator needs a multilingual song draft.

prompt_templates.title: Repair a track section
prompt_templates.prompt: Inpaint the audio at [URL] from [start] to [end] seconds. Match [style], replace the section with [change], and preserve surrounding continuity.
prompt_templates.scenario: A producer needs to replace a timed passage.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a budgeted music batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan [count] tracks of [duration] for [project]. Compare suitable models, estimate total cost, vary prompts, and wait for approval before generation.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs an advanced batch workflow with cost control.

output_examples.input: Create a 45-second calm electronic instrumental for a product tutorial.
output_examples.output: Selected ACE Step base for economical drafting. Prepared tags for calm electronic textures, steady rhythm, instrumental output, and a 45-second duration.

output_examples.input: Write a polished 20-second vocal jingle with clear sections for a brand campaign.
output_examples.output: Selected ElevenLabs Music for premium vocals. Structured the brief with an intro, short verse, memorable chorus, and exact duration.

output_examples.input: Extend my 30-second instrumental with a 15-second intro and 45-second outro.
output_examples.output: Selected ACE Step audio-outpaint. Prepared one bidirectional edit using the supplied audio URL, matching style tags, and requested extension lengths.

best_practices: Start with short drafts, compare results, and increase duration only after the style is stable.
Use specific genre, instrumentation, tempo, mood, vocal, and section details.
Review estimated cost, content rights, and external-data handling before each final generation.
anti_patterns: Do not submit secrets, confidential lyrics, or private audio URLs to external model services.
Do not use a premium model for large draft batches without checking total cost.
Do not edit audio without precise time boundaries and a user-approved source URL.

faq.question: Which music models can this skill use?
faq.answer: It routes requests to ElevenLabs Music, ACE Step base, ACE Step 1.5, ACE Step inpainting, and ACE Step outpainting.

faq.question: Can it create instrumental music?
faq.answer: Yes. It can prepare instrumental requests for background tracks, jingles, soundtracks, and game loops.

faq.question: Can it generate songs in multiple languages?
faq.answer: Yes. ACE Step 1.5 is the primary route for multilingual vocals, while ElevenLabs Music supports premium vocal work.

faq.question: Can it fix only one section of a song?
faq.answer: Yes. ACE Step audio-inpaint can replace a user-defined time range inside compatible source audio.

faq.question: Does it require payment?
faq.answer: RunComfy models are priced services. Cost depends on the selected model, track duration, and number of generations.

faq.question: Where are generated files saved?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI downloads generated audio to the output directory selected for the command.
